_rules: Manual category per sampled latent, assigned by reading the per-token peaks (10 split-A texts, 10 bank-F2 texts, 5 top non-c* split-A texts) in q1_latents.jsonl. format = the peak sits on a structural cue of encyclopedia text (birth-date parentheses, codes, units, dates, the 'X is a ... Y' definition, credit lines such as 'directed by' / 'book by', CV or template boilerplate); the topic word may be the peak token, but only inside that frame. name_entity = the peak sits on a proper name or a piece of one (a person, place, organisation, acronym, title of a work), not on the subject matter. topic = the peak sits on content words of the subject, wherever they occur, and it also fires on on-topic texts in other styles. other = none of these fits clearly.
